facts.statement: For the President's Day long weekend, all housing and land items sold for Station Cash were discounted 50%.
facts.quote: TOUS les articles du logement et des terrains de Station Cash à 50% de réduction

facts.statement: The President's Day sale ran from 21:00 CET on 18 February 2011 until 08:59 CET on 22 February 2011.
facts.quote: commencera à 21h CET (Heure de Paris) le 18 février jusqu’au 8h:59 CET le 22 Février 2011

facts.statement: A weekend-only promotion offered all houses and lots at 50% off on the Marketplace, valid from 12:01am PST 2/17/12 to 11:59pm PST 2/20/12.
facts.quote: This weekend only*, we’re offering all houses and lots for 50% off on the Marketplace!

article_summaries.title: Soldes de President's Day! (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language Free Realms news post announcing a President's Day weekend sale in February 2011: all housing and land items in the Station Cash marketplace were discounted 50%. The sale ran from 21:00 CET on 18 February to 08:59 CET on 22 February 2011. The page's exact post date is not shown; it is dated only by the sale window.

article_summaries.title: Shop the President's Day Sale – Save Up to 50%!!
article_summaries.summary: A President's Day weekend sale (valid 12:01am PST 2/17/12 to 11:59pm PST 2/20/12) offering housing and lots at 50% off on the Marketplace and discounted TCG booster packs and starter decks from Sets 1-3. The post lists the Shard (SC) prices of houses and lots during the sale, which a rebuilder can use as a sale-period price table.
